The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] had a '''Command Sector''' located in the southern hemisphere. It was located at the southern pole of the [[battle station]], below the [[Mid-Hemisphere Trench (South)|Mid-Hemisphere Trench]]<ref name="EGVV" /> and the [[South Polar Trench]].<ref name="TPotF">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Death Star with Darth Vader|link=POTF2cgvader.asp}}</ref>
